name: Synapse Helper
description: Site-building helper for Synapse/Synatix projects: search-engine no-index control, FZ-152 / GDPR consent on contact & register forms, a cookie-consent banner, a /policy and /demo-page renderer, Yandex Metrica + Yandex Ecommerce tracking, contact-message normalization, Commerce content export/import services and Drush commands.
project_description: Synapse Helper (synhelper) is a grab-bag site-building helper used by the Synapse/Synatix installation profile and its sites. From a single settings form at /admin/config/synapse/synhelper it can forbid search-engine indexing site-wide (and specifically for a 1c.* subdomain), add a Russian FZ-152 personal-data consent checkbox to every contact form and to the user register form, show a cookie-consent notice, and inject a Yandex Metrica counter (with optional Yandex Ecommerce dataLayer events and per-form conversion goals). It renders a shipped privacy policy at /policy and a demo styles page at /demo-page from static assets. Beyond configuration it ships hook implementations that normalize submitted contact_message entities, alter Commerce checkout and product markup, transliterate uploaded filenames, and deliberately steer administrators (pre-filling checkboxes, warning on the module-update UI). It also provides content export/import services for Commerce entities and Drush commands (synhelper:phpstorm, synhelper:sqlite-vacuum, synhelper:cim, plus a synhelper:export console command). Depends on the idna module. Most behavior is gated by admin-only configuration; the public routes are read-only pages.
